messages:
maya: Heads-up — I'm seeing a small regressed p95 on H100 long-seq workloads after last night's kernel chooser change. Only hits on INT4/FP8 mixed paths.
chao: ugh, saw that in CI perf dash. Can you paste the probe trace?
maya: attaching snippet from perfprobe:```
model: red-t5-xl
arch: h100-sm92
seq: 1024
path: int4_fp8_mixed_pick
latency_p95: 218ms (prev: 185ms)
kv_warmup: cold (first 10 tokens)
batch_size: 1
```
maya: The autotuner appears to pick the mixed INT4/FP8 kernel for >768 seq, which we tuned for throughput, but it hurts tail for cold KV.
tiffany: That matches my local repro — warmup cost + kernel launch overhead dominates for small concurrent batches. The per-arch penalty on SM92 is ~15-18% for the mixed path on first chunk.
chao: Did the chooser add a new seq-threshold heuristic? I thought we only used cost-curve + kv-pressure.
maya: We added a seqlen_bias factor in the last change to prefer lower-accuracy kernels for long sequences to save tokens. Looks like it unintentionally ignores kv_cold flag.
sam: @maya can you run a quick A/B: force fallback to int8 kernel when kv_cold==true and seq>512 and report numbers? If p95 drops we're good to revert seqlen_bias for cold starts.
maya: Ran it. Results:```
A: mixed (current) p95=218ms
B: int8 fallback when kv_cold p95=176ms
mem: +0.4GB
throughput: -6%
```
maya: So it's a cold-start tail issue. Throughput trade-off expected.
tiffany: Makes sense. For interactive latency we prefer lower p95 even if throughput drops a bit. We should add kv_warmth to the scoring function and a hysteresis to avoid flipflop.
chao: Agreed. Proposed change: score = base_cost * (1 + seqlen_bias*seq_norm) * (1 - kv_warmth_factor) with kv_warmth in [0,1]. Add hysteresis window of 200 tokens before switching picks.
sam: Also add a small launch_cost estimate per kernel (measured per-arch) so tiny batches don't get penalized by fp8 kernel startups. We have bench numbers from pickbench.
maya: I'll push a patch that: (1) adds kv_warmth into scoring, (2) uses per-arch launch_cost table, (3) seqlen hysteresis. Test plan: microbench on sm92+sm95, CI perf-run + large-hosted trace.
chao: Please include a config override so we can A/B in prod for dedicated customers.
maya: Yep. Patch PR incoming, I'll tag with perf/regress and ping this thread.
build-bot: deploy-checks: unit-tests passed, integration-tests queued. :gear:
maya: thx — spawning replay tools to validate long trace now. Will post results in ~30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
